text: The document is a CIKM submission plan (10-page sigconf) for QDCVR, a content-verified retrieval system for agentic knowledge bases. Proposed title: "Content-Verified Retrieval with Experience-Grounded Credibility for Agentic Knowledge Bases." Structure spans seven sections: Introduction, Related Work, QDCVR Methodology (two-stage recall plus content verification and confidence/blind-spot stages), Experience Lifecycle (E0–E12, P0/P1/P2), Implementation (94 MCP tools), Evaluation, Discussion. Benchmarks comprise Datasets A–E; Dataset C is core with 40+ queries across five types, reporting P@5, R@5, nDCG@5, FPR and blind-spot rates. Annotation requires three annotators, Cohen's κ≥0.7. RQ1–6 map to Tables 2–5, with ablations in Table 3. Statistics use five runs, paired t-tests, p<0.05. Baselines include BM25, BGE-M3, CRAG and Self-RAG.
